_comment: Hand-reviewed goal presets (researched from the OSRS wiki, 2026-10-17). Each crop names a seed exactly as in seeds.json. perProduct: harvested items one product needs; avgYieldPerPatch: average harvest per patch (0 when not meaningful, e.g. trees grown for logs or XP), used to share a patch kind between a goal's crops. Notes and wiki links record where the numbers came from.
_sources: Recipes, ingredient counts and payments read from OSRS Wiki raw wikitext via the MediaWiki API (October 2026); seed names/kinds/levels/XP/payments from seeds.json. avgYieldPerPatch for harvest-lives crops is computed with the wiki's own Module:Farming yield calculator formula (lives / (1 - chanceToSave), CTS low/high taken from each seed page's {{Farming yield calculator}}) at Farming 80 (or the crop's requirement if higher), ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/Farming cape/attas; limpwurt uses the module's dedicated formula; grapes use the Grape vine page's chart values. yieldBasis: formula (wiki formula), fixed (game mechanic), minimum (guaranteed floor because the wiki publishes no formula), estimate (interpolated/assumed), none (not a per-patch harvest). perProduct is per 3-dose potion unless productUnit says otherwise. xpPerPatch appears only on Farming XP presets.

presets.name: Prayer potion
presets.why: Core prayer restore for every ironman PvM trip until super restores are steady; both ingredients are farmable.

crops.note: grimy ranarr weed; 1 per 3-dose potion; Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~9.2 at 99)
snape grass; 1 per potion; Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~37.5 at 99)

presets.name: Super restore (incl. Sanfew serum)
presets.why: Restores prayer and drained stats; the brew/restore pair is the backbone of ironman bossing.

crops.note: grimy snapdragon; 1 per 3-dose potion; Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~9.2 at 99)

notFarmed: Sanfew serum also needs unicorn horn dust, snake weed and nail beast nails

presets.name: Saradomin brew
presets.why: Main high-healing potion for ironman bossing (paired with super restores).

crops.note: grimy toadflax; 1 per 3-dose brew; Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~9.2 at 99)

notFarmed: Crushed nest (1 per brew; bird nests come from Woodcutting/nest drops, not patches)

presets.name: Ranging potion (incl. Divine)
presets.why: Standard ranged boost; dwarf weed is the bottleneck for ironmen, and wine of Zamorak can be grown at the vinery.

crops.note: grimy dwarf weed; 1 per 3-dose potion; Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~9.2 at 99)

Zamorak's grapes -> wine of Zamorak (jug of water, Cooking 65; ~50% success at 65 rising to 100% at 98, so budget up to 2 grapes per wine at low Cooking). Picking Zamorak's grapes at the Hosidius vinery consumes 1 Bologa's blessing per grape (Tithe Farm shop; unlock needs 50 Prayer, 65 Cooking, 75k to Bologa). Yield: 5 lives, magic secateurs + sulphurous fertiliser, Farming 80, from the wiki's Grape vine yield chart (~22.9 at 99; ~9.6 without fertiliser).

notFarmed: Crystal dust for the divine version (from crystal shards)
Wine of Zamorak can instead be telegrabbed or looted if the vinery is skipped

presets.name: Super combat potion (incl. Divine)
presets.why: Best melee boost; every herb plus limpwurt and white berries are farmable.

crops.note: grimy torstol; 1 per super combat(4); Farming 85, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~9.2 at 99)

grimy irit leaf; super attack; 4/3 per super combat(4) because a 4-dose super is 4/3 of a 3-dose potion; Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~9.2 at 99)
grimy kwuarm; super strength; 4/3 per super combat(4); Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~9.2 at 99)
grimy cadantine; super defence; 4/3 per super combat(4); Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~9.2 at 99)
super strength secondary, 4/3 per super combat(4); limpwurt root; 3 + floor(rand(0..floor(F*1.10)-1)/10) with magic secateurs, compost has no effect; wiki module formula at Farming 80 (~7.9 at 99)

white berries (super defence secondary, 4/3 per super combat(4)); 4 is the guaranteed minimum per harvest - the wiki says a level-scaled random bonus is added (magic secateurs apply) but publishes no formula, so the real average is higher. Bushes regrow (~80 min) so later runs can harvest again.

notFarmed: Crystal dust for the divine version

presets.name: Antifire / Extended / Super antifire
presets.why: Required for dragons (Vorkath, metal dragons, KBD); lantadyme is the only farmable input.

crops.note: grimy lantadyme; 1 per 3-dose antifire (extended and super versions upgrade an antifire); Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~9.2 at 99)

presets.name: Stamina potion (super energy)
presets.why: Run energy for nearly every ironman activity; avantoe makes the super energy base.

crops.note: grimy avantoe; 1 per 3-dose super energy (= stamina(3) with 3 amylase); Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~9.2 at 99)

notFarmed: Amylase crystal (1 per dose, Mark of grace shop)

presets.name: Anti-venom+
presets.why: Venom immunity for Zulrah, Vorkath and Hydra; irit, coconut, magic roots and torstol all come from patches.

crops.note: grimy irit leaf; 1 per antidote++(4); Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~9.2 at 99)
coconut -> half coconut -> coconut milk (1 per antidote++(4)); a grown fruit tree holds 6 fruit and regrows 1 every 40 min (fixed, not affected by compost/secateurs).
magic roots, dug from the stump after chopping a grown magic tree: 1 at Farming 75-82, 2 at 83, 3 at 91, 4 at 99 (boosts count). 1 root per antidote++(4) - this is the bottleneck.
grimy torstol; 1 per anti-venom+(4); not needed for plain anti-venom; Farming 85, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~9.2 at 99)

presets.name: Super antipoison
presets.why: Cheap poison cure/immunity for poisonous Slayer tasks before anti-venom is practical.

crops.note: grimy irit leaf; 1 per 3-dose potion; Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~9.2 at 99)

presets.name: Magic potion (incl. Divine)
presets.why: +4 Magic boost for bossing and level boosts; both ingredients are farmable.

crops.note: grimy lantadyme; 1 per 3-dose potion; Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~9.2 at 99)

potato cactus; 1 per potion. 6 is the guaranteed minimum (wiki infobox '6+'); the Farming page's experimental estimate is 15-20 per patch at 99 with secateurs. CTS unpublished. Regrows fully in ~35 min.

notFarmed: Crystal dust for the divine version

presets.name: Zamorak brew
presets.why: Attack/Strength boost (with Defence/HP penalty) for niche setups and boosting; fully farmable.

crops.note: grimy torstol; 1 per 3-dose brew; Farming 85, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~9.2 at 99)

jangerberries; 1 per brew; 4 is the guaranteed minimum per harvest - the wiki says a level-scaled random bonus is added (magic secateurs apply) but publishes no formula, so the real average is higher. Bushes regrow (~80 min) so later runs can harvest again.

presets.name: Bastion potion (incl. Divine)
presets.why: Combined Ranged + Defence boost (replaces ranging potion + super defence).

crops.note: grimy cadantine; 1 per 3-dose potion; Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~9.2 at 99)

Zamorak's grapes -> wine of Zamorak (jug of water, Cooking 65; ~50% success at 65 rising to 100% at 98, so budget up to 2 grapes per wine at low Cooking). Picking Zamorak's grapes at the Hosidius vinery consumes 1 Bologa's blessing per grape (Tithe Farm shop; unlock needs 50 Prayer, 65 Cooking, 75k to Bologa). Yield: 5 lives, magic secateurs + sulphurous fertiliser, Farming 80, from the wiki's Grape vine yield chart (~22.9 at 99; ~9.6 without fertiliser).

notFarmed: Vial of blood (for cadantine blood potion (unf))
Crystal dust for the divine version

presets.name: Battlemage potion (incl. Divine)
presets.why: Combined Magic + Defence boost; cadantine and potato cactus are farmable.

crops.note: grimy cadantine; 1 per 3-dose potion; Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~9.2 at 99)

potato cactus; 1 per potion. 6 is the guaranteed minimum (wiki infobox '6+'); the Farming page's experimental estimate is 15-20 per patch at 99 with secateurs. CTS unpublished. Regrows fully in ~35 min.

notFarmed: Vial of blood (for cadantine blood potion (unf))
Crystal dust for the divine version

presets.name: Prayer regeneration potion
presets.why: Prayer drain offset for long fights; huasca is the only farmable input (seeds drop in Varlamore).

crops.note: grimy huasca; 1 per 3-dose potion. ESTIMATE: the wiki gives no CTS for huasca (it says it uses the normal herb harvest-lives mechanic), so CTS low=59 was interpolated between snapdragon (57) and cadantine (60), high=80 like all herbs; Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs (~9.2 at 99)

presets.name: Armadyl brew
presets.why: Sailing-era ranged brew (heals over max and boosts Ranged); umbral coral grows in the coral nursery.

crops.note: umbral coral; 1 per 3-dose brew (vial of water + coral = umbral potion (unf)). Coral nurseries take no compost (fixed 6 lives); wiki calculator with magic secateurs at Farming 80 (~25.6 at 99). Whether secateurs affect coral is not confirmed - the wiki calculator assumes they do.

presets.name: Summer pie
presets.why: +5 Agility per bite plus 22 HP fast food: the standard ironman Agility training/boost food; all fillings are farmed.

crops.note: strawberry; 1 per pie; Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~26.9 at 99)
watermelon; 1 per pie; Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~26.9 at 99)
cooking apple; 1 per pie; a grown fruit tree holds 6 fruit and regrows 1 every 40 min (fixed, not affected by compost/secateurs).

presets.name: Garden pie
presets.why: +3 Farming per bite: plant crops a few levels early (e.g. torstol/celastrus at 82); cheap low-level allotment crops.

crops.note: tomato; 1 per pie; Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~26.9 at 99)
onion; 1 per pie; Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~26.9 at 99)
cabbage; 1 per pie; Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~26.9 at 99)

presets.name: Jug of wine
presets.why: 200 Cooking XP each (no failures from Cooking 68) and, blessed at Ralos' Rise, Prayer training; the Hosidius vinery is the ironman grape source.

crops.note: grapes; 1 per jug. 5 harvest lives, magic secateurs + sulphurous fertiliser (+~180% grapes), Farming 80, from the wiki's Grape vine yield chart (~40.0 at 99; ~11.2 without fertiliser). Vine patches need saltpetre before planting.

presets.name: Pineapple pizza
presets.why: 22 HP two-bite fast food at Cooking 65; one pineapple tops four pizzas.

crops.note: pineapple; cut into 4 rings, 1 ring per pizza; a grown fruit tree holds 6 fruit and regrows 1 every 40 min (fixed, not affected by compost/secateurs).
tomato; 1 per pizza; Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~26.9 at 99)

presets.name: Tuna potato
presets.why: 22 HP one-bite food at Cooking 68 (ties manta ray/anglerfish/dark crab); potato and sweetcorn are farmed.

crops.note: potato; 1 per tuna potato (baked, then buttered); Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~26.9 at 99)
sweetcorn; 1 per tuna potato (via tuna and corn); Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~26.9 at 99)

presets.name: Bow strings (flax)
presets.why: Ironmen need thousands of bow strings for Fletching; flax also spins into linen yarn (Sailing) and pays for hemp.

crops.note: flax; 1 per bow string (spinning wheel or Spin Flax); Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~36.6 at 99)

presets.name: Bolt of canvas (hemp, Sailing)
presets.why: Sailing mast & sail upgrades for teak, mahogany and camphor boats use bolts of canvas.

crops.note: hemp -> hemp yarn (1:1); 2 yarn per bolt of canvas (Crafting 39); Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~25.6 at 99)

presets.name: Bolt of cotton (cotton, Sailing)
presets.why: Ironwood and rosewood boat sails use bolts of cotton; cotton yarn also makes haemostatic dressings.

crops.note: cotton boll -> cotton yarn (1:1); 2 yarn per bolt of cotton (Crafting 73); Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~15.5 at 99)

presets.name: Molten glass (giant seaweed)
presets.why: Superglass Make with giant seaweed is the ironman's main molten glass source for Crafting XP.

crops.note: giant seaweed; 3 seaweed + 18 buckets of sand per Superglass Make cast (~28.8 molten glass), i.e. ~0.10 seaweed per glass. Magic secateurs do NOT apply to seaweed; ultracompost, Farming 80 (~34.1 at 99).

presets.name: Battlestaves (celastrus)
presets.why: Ironmen have few battlestaff sources; celastrus bark is the farmable one (elemental staves/Crafting XP).

crops.note: celastrus bark; 1 per battlestaff (Fletching 40). 3 is the guaranteed minimum (harvest-lives mechanic; ultracompost, secateurs and attas raise it); the wiki's experimental estimate is 8-10 per tree at 99 with ultracompost + secateurs. CTS not published. The tree does not regrow bark.

presets.name: Teak & mahogany logs (Construction/Sailing)
presets.why: Planks for Construction and early Sailing hulls/sails; farmed hardwoods give logs without Fossil Island chopping trips.

crops.note: teak logs; 1 per teak plank. Farmed hardwood trees are chopped like normal trees, so logs per tree depend on Woodcutting depletion - the wiki gives no fixed yield.
mahogany logs; 1 per mahogany plank. Logs per tree not fixed (chop until depleted).

notFarmed: Coins or runes for the sawmill / Plank Make

presets.name: Camphor & ironwood logs (Sailing)
presets.why: Camphor and ironwood planks are the mid/high-tier Sailing boat materials; farming them avoids trips to the Great Conch/Sunbleak Island.

crops.note: camphor logs; 1 per camphor plank. Logs per tree not fixed (chop until depleted).
ironwood logs; 1 per ironwood plank. Logs per tree not fixed (chop until depleted).

notFarmed: Coins or runes for the sawmill / Plank Make

presets.name: Tree run XP (Farming 75+)
presets.why: Highest XP-per-run trees available below 81: magic, palm and calquat.

crops.note: magic tree; xpPerPatch = plant + check-health (+ harvest where listed) from seeds.json. Protect with 25 coconuts.
palm tree (6 coconuts); xpPerPatch = plant + check-health (+ harvest where listed) from seeds.json. Protect with 15 papaya.
calquat tree (6 calquat fruit at 48.5 XP each included); xpPerPatch = plant + check-health (+ harvest where listed) from seeds.json. Protect with 8 poison ivy berries.

presets.name: Tree run XP (Farming 85+)
presets.why: End-game daily tree run: magic, dragonfruit, calquat, spirit tree and celastrus.

crops.note: magic tree; xpPerPatch = plant + check-health (+ harvest where listed) from seeds.json.
dragonfruit tree (6 dragonfruit); xpPerPatch = plant + check-health (+ harvest where listed) from seeds.json. Protect with 15 coconuts.
calquat tree (6 fruit included); xpPerPatch = plant + check-health (+ harvest where listed) from seeds.json.
spirit tree; xpPerPatch = plant + check-health (+ harvest where listed) from seeds.json. Protect with 5 monkey nuts + monkey bar + ground tooth.
celastrus tree (+23.5 XP per bark, 3 bark minimum counted); xpPerPatch = plant + check-health (+ harvest where listed) from seeds.json. Protect with 8 potato cacti.

presets.name: Hardwood XP (Farming 80+)
presets.why: Ironwood gives the most XP per hardwood patch below 92 (20k+ per tree on a ~3.5 day cycle).

crops.note: ironwood tree; xpPerPatch = plant + check-health (+ harvest where listed) from seeds.json. Protect with 10 curry leaves.

notFarmed: Mahogany (55, ~15.8k XP) and camphor (66, ~17.9k XP) are the lower-level fallbacks

presets.name: Redwood & rosewood XP (Farming 92)
presets.why: Largest single-patch XP in the game for later; both are protected with dragonfruit.

crops.note: redwood tree; xpPerPatch = plant + check-health (+ harvest where listed) from seeds.json. Protect with 6 dragonfruit.
rosewood tree; xpPerPatch = plant + check-health (+ harvest where listed) from seeds.json. Protect with 8 dragonfruit.

presets.name: Herb/allotment/hops XP
presets.why: Best XP from the fast patches between tree runs: snape grass (~2.5k per allotment), dwarf weed, cotton, white lily, poison ivy.

crops.note: snape grass; xpPerPatch = plant XP + harvest XP x average yield at Farming 80 (ultracompost, magic secateurs).
grimy dwarf weed (switch to torstol at 85); xpPerPatch = plant XP + harvest XP x average yield at Farming 80 (ultracompost, magic secateurs).
cotton boll; xpPerPatch = plant XP + harvest XP x average yield at Farming 80 (ultracompost, magic secateurs).
white lily; also protects neighbouring allotments from disease.
poison ivy berries; xpPerPatch = plant + check-health + 4 berries x 45 (guaranteed minimum; real average higher, formula unpublished). Never diseases, no payment needed.

presets.name: Coconuts (magic & dragonfruit payment)
presets.why: 25 coconuts protect a magic tree and 15 a dragonfruit tree; palm trees are the ironman's coconut source.

crops.note: coconut; 25 per magic tree (15 per dragonfruit tree); a grown fruit tree holds 6 fruit and regrows 1 every 40 min (fixed, not affected by compost/secateurs).

presets.name: Papaya (palm tree payment)
presets.why: 15 papaya protect a palm tree.

crops.note: papaya fruit; 15 per palm tree; a grown fruit tree holds 6 fruit and regrows 1 every 40 min (fixed, not affected by compost/secateurs).

presets.name: Cactus spines (yew payment)
presets.why: 10 cactus spines protect a yew tree.

crops.note: cactus spine; 10 per yew. Minimum 3 spines; chance to use a life is 75% at 55 and 30% at 99 (2018 news post, quoted on the Farming page) - linear interpolation assumed, compost effect on spines not documented so ignored, secateurs don't apply; Farming 80 (~10 at 99). Cactus regrows after harvest.

presets.name: Dragonfruit (redwood & rosewood payment)
presets.why: 6 dragonfruit protect a redwood and 8 a rosewood.

crops.note: dragonfruit; 8 per rosewood (6 per redwood); a grown fruit tree holds 6 fruit and regrows 1 every 40 min (fixed, not affected by compost/secateurs).

presets.name: Hardwood payments
presets.why: Protection for the four hardwoods plantable below 92: limpwurt (teak), yanillian hops (mahogany), white berries (camphor), curry leaves (ironwood).

crops.note: 15 limpwurt roots per teak tree; limpwurt root; 3 + floor(rand(0..floor(F*1.10)-1)/10) with magic secateurs, compost has no effect; wiki module formula at Farming 80 (~7.9 at 99)
yanillian hops; 25 per mahogany tree; Farming 80, ultracompost, magic secateurs, no diary/cape/attas; wiki 'Farming yield calculator' CTS formula (~26.9 at 99)

white berries; 10 per camphor tree; 4 is the guaranteed minimum per harvest - the wiki says a level-scaled random bonus is added (magic secateurs apply) but publishes no formula, so the real average is higher. Bushes regrow (~80 min) so later runs can harvest again.
curry leaf; 10 per ironwood tree; a grown fruit tree holds 6 fruit and regrows 1 every 40 min (fixed, not affected by compost/secateurs).

presets.name: Celastrus & calquat payments
presets.why: 8 potato cacti protect a celastrus tree and 8 poison ivy berries a calquat tree.

crops.note: 8 per celastrus tree; potato cactus; 6 is the guaranteed minimum (wiki infobox '6+'); the Farming page's experimental estimate is 15-20 per patch at 99 with secateurs. CTS unpublished. Regrows fully in ~35 min.

poison ivy berries; 8 per calquat tree; 4 is the guaranteed minimum per harvest - the wiki says a level-scaled random bonus is added (magic secateurs apply) but publishes no formula, so the real average is higher. Bushes regrow (~80 min) so later runs can harvest again.
